name: 19054 · Levittown, PA
findings: ZIP 19054 (Levittown) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19054 (Levittown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19054 (Levittown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
